strings.zh: 执着于得到某一只精灵的人,{NEWLINE}往往是求而不得。{CLEAR}像施主这样福泽深厚的人,{CLEAR}却往往是不求而得。{CLEAR}这大概就是命吧。
strings.en: Those who cling to getting one{NEWLINE}particular Pokémon often seek it and{CLEAR}never find it.{SCROLL}Yet those as richly blessed as you,{NEWLINE}traveler, often find it without seeking.{CLEAR}Perhaps that is simply fate.

strings.zh: 你仔细观察一下缘朱市的建筑排布,{NEWLINE}就会发现这里的建筑基本都是{CLEAR}以这条中央大道为对称轴排布的。{SCROLL}以这种对称风格规划城市建筑的{NEWLINE}一般都是古代的都城。{CLEAR}从这一点上也可以看出{CLEAR}缘朱市在城都地区历史中的地位。
strings.en: If you look closely at the{NEWLINE}layout of Ecruteak City,{CLEAR}you’ll notice the buildings are almost{CLEAR}all arranged symmetrically along this{CLEAR}central avenue.{SCROLL}Cities planned in this symmetrical style{NEWLINE}were usually ancient capitals.{SCROLL}That alone shows Ecruteak City’s place{NEWLINE}in Johto’s history.

strings.zh: 这边这栋房子里住着祖孙二人,{NEWLINE}孙女对奶奶非常孝顺,{CLEAR}经常带着奶奶去各地旅游。{CLEAR}每当他们出去的时候,{CLEAR}就会留下吸盘魔偶在家里打扫家务。
strings.en: A grandmother and her granddaughter{NEWLINE}live in this house here.{CLEAR}The granddaughter is devoted to her{CLEAR}grandma and often takes her traveling{CLEAR}all over.{SCROLL}Whenever they go out, they leave their{NEWLINE}Mr. Mime at home to do the housework.

strings.zh: 不过他们这次出去{NEWLINE}旅游的时间好像挺长的,{CLEAR}我已经好久都没看到他们了。
strings.en: But they seem to have been{NEWLINE}gone quite a while this time.{CLEAR}I haven’t seen them in ages.

strings.zh: 雷公、炎帝、水君被尊称为{NEWLINE}城都地区的三圣兽。{CLEAR}从缘朱市的传说故事来看,{CLEAR}我觉得他们能被称为圣兽{CLEAR}不仅仅是因为自身的强大,{CLEAR}它们在传说故事中所表现出的{CLEAR}对凤王知恩图报、忠诚勇敢的精神,{CLEAR}也是人们尊重它们的原因吧。
strings.en: Raikou, Entei and Suicune are revered{NEWLINE}as Johto’s three legendary beasts.{SCROLL}Going by Ecruteak City’s legends,{NEWLINE}I don’t think they’re revered just{CLEAR}because they’re powerful.{SCROLL}The gratitude, loyalty and courage they{NEWLINE}showed Ho-Oh in those legends must be{CLEAR}why people respect them too.

strings.zh: 缘朱市的道馆馆主小松,{NEWLINE}以成为凤王的训练家为目标{CLEAR}而努力修行着。{SCROLL}小松有一个好朋友叫米那君,{NEWLINE}据说他也以成为水君的训练家为目标{CLEAR}而不断努力探索。{SCROLL}我觉得无论他们最后能否成功,{NEWLINE}只要为了这个目标全力以赴过{CLEAR}人生就没有遗憾了。
strings.en: Morty, Ecruteak City’s Gym Leader,{NEWLINE}trains hard with the goal of becoming{CLEAR}Ho-Oh’s Trainer.{SCROLL}Morty has a good friend named Eusine.{NEWLINE}They say he’s also searching tirelessly,{CLEAR}with the goal of becoming{CLEAR}Suicune’s Trainer.{SCROLL}I think whether or not they succeed in{NEWLINE}the end, as long as they give it{CLEAR}everything they’ve got, they’ll have{CLEAR}no regrets in life.

strings.zh: 缘朱市跟桔梗市一样,{NEWLINE}对传统的建筑风格保留得非常好。{SCROLL}或许是因为这里的人们{NEWLINE}希望凤王回归时,{CLEAR}能够一眼就认出城市原本的样貌吧。
strings.en: Like Violet City, Ecruteak City has{NEWLINE}preserved its traditional architecture{CLEAR}very well.{SCROLL}Maybe the people here want Ho-Oh to{NEWLINE}recognize the city at a glance when{CLEAR}it comes back.

It’s not much to look{CLEAR}at, but it’s a rare kind you can’t fish{CLEAR}up anywhere in Johto.{SCROLL}Trade a Goldeen for Feebas?

strings.zh: 雷公是最强的三圣兽,{NEWLINE}水君克炎帝,雷公克水君。{CLEAR}所以雷公最厉害！{CLEAR}炎帝只是三圣兽入门级实力,{CLEAR}雷公才是三圣兽顶级实力。
strings.en: Raikou is the strongest of the three{NEWLINE}legendary beasts. Suicune beats Entei,{CLEAR}and Raikou beats Suicune.{CLEAR}So of course Raikou is the strongest!{SCROLL}Entei is only entry-level among the{NEWLINE}three beasts. Raikou is top-tier.

strings.zh: 雷公又不克制炎帝,{NEWLINE}你凭什么说雷公比炎帝厉害。{SCROLL}三圣兽中最厉害的应该是炎帝！{NEWLINE}它那个神圣的火焰{CLEAR}就跟凤王的火焰一模一样。{CLEAR}凤王是三圣兽的首领,{CLEAR}炎帝跟首领一样,{CLEAR}所以当然是炎帝厉害了！
strings.en: Raikou doesn’t even beat Entei,{NEWLINE}so how can you say Raikou’s stronger{CLEAR}than Entei?{SCROLL}Entei is the strongest of the three{NEWLINE}legendary beasts! Its sacred fire is{CLEAR}exactly the same as Ho-Oh’s.{SCROLL}Ho-Oh is the leader of the three{NEWLINE}beasts, and Entei is just like{CLEAR}the leader, so of course Entei is{CLEAR}the strongest!

strings.zh: 你说是1就是1,你说是3就是3啊。{NEWLINE}我还说炎帝的100,雷公是0呢！
strings.en: So if you say 1, it’s 1, and if you say 3,{NEWLINE}it’s 3? Then I say Entei’s a 100 and{CLEAR}Raikou’s a 0!

strings.zh: 不管谁说什么,{NEWLINE}在我心目中炎帝就是最强的。
strings.en: No matter what anyone says,{NEWLINE}Entei is the strongest in my heart.

strings.zh: 不管谁说什么,{NEWLINE}在我心目中雷公就是最强的。
strings.en: No matter what anyone says,{NEWLINE}Raikou is the strongest in my heart.

strings.zh: 说出来你可能不信,{NEWLINE}我年轻的时候再46号路,{CLEAR}也就是黑暗洞穴南边那条路,{CLEAR}见到过凤王在那里落下休息。{CLEAR}当凤王飞走的时候,{CLEAR}它身上还掉下来一根{CLEAR}非常漂亮的彩虹色羽毛。
strings.en: You may not believe this, but when I{NEWLINE}was young, I saw Ho-Oh land to rest on{CLEAR}Route 46, the road south of Dark Cave.{SCROLL}When Ho-Oh flew off again,{NEWLINE}a beautiful rainbow-colored feather fell{CLEAR}from its body.

strings.zh: 传说中凤王身披彩霞{NEWLINE}飞翔而过的样子一定非常美丽。{CLEAR}但很遗憾那只是传说中的精灵。{CLEAR}我很想知道普通精灵中,{CLEAR}有没有像凤王那样惊艳的美丽精灵。{CLEAR}如果你有这样的精灵,{CLEAR}能给我看一看吗？
strings.en: In the legends, Ho-Oh must have{NEWLINE}looked so beautiful flying past,{CLEAR}wrapped in rainbow clouds.{CLEAR}Sadly, it’s only a legendary Pokémon.{SCROLL}I’d love to know if any ordinary Pokémon{NEWLINE}are as stunning as Ho-Oh. If you have{CLEAR}one like that, could you show it to me?

strings.zh: 果然像凤王那么美丽的精灵{NEWLINE}并不常见啊。
strings.en: I guess Pokémon as beautiful as Ho-Oh{NEWLINE}really are rare.

strings.zh: 你这只精灵的外表感觉很普通,{NEWLINE}并没有让我觉得很惊艳。
strings.en: Your Pokémon looks pretty ordinary.{NEWLINE}It doesn’t really wow me.

strings.zh: 哇,这昂扬挺拔的身姿,{NEWLINE}这飘逸的火焰,{CLEAR}还真有点传说中凤王的感觉！{SCROLL}谢谢你让我看到这么惊艳的精灵,{NEWLINE}这个送给你就当做是感谢吧。
strings.en: Wow, that proud, upright stance,{NEWLINE}those flowing flames! It really does{CLEAR}remind me of the legendary Ho-Oh!{SCROLL}Thank you for showing me such a{NEWLINE}stunning Pokémon. Please take this{CLEAR}as thanks.

strings.zh: 这不是大嘴雀吗？{NEWLINE}这样的精灵也能算是……
strings.en: Isn’t this a Fearow? How could a{NEWLINE}Pokémon like this count as...

strings.zh: 哦！不！这修长的嘴巴,张开的双翼！{NEWLINE}这不是跟画册里的凤王一模一样吗？{SCROLL}谢谢你让我看到{NEWLINE}跟凤王这么像的精灵,{CLEAR}这个送给你就当做是感谢吧。
strings.en: Oh! No, wait! That long beak, those{NEWLINE}spread wings! Isn’t it just like the{CLEAR}Ho-Oh in my picture book?{SCROLL}Thank you for showing me a{NEWLINE}Pokémon so much like Ho-Oh.{CLEAR}Please take this as thanks.
strings.notes: RV040: meaning: 哦！不！ is the speaker reversing, not dismay

strings.zh: 哇,这修长光滑的身躯,{NEWLINE}这迷人的线条、灵动的眼睛,{CLEAR}虽然与凤王不同但是真的很美！{SCROLL}谢谢你让我看到这么惊艳的精灵,{NEWLINE}这个送给你就当做是感谢吧。
strings.en: Wow, that long, sleek body, those{NEWLINE}graceful curves, those lively eyes!{CLEAR}It’s nothing like Ho-Oh, but it’s{CLEAR}truly beautiful!{SCROLL}Thank you for showing me such a{NEWLINE}stunning Pokémon. Please take this{CLEAR}as thanks.

strings.zh: 听说浅葱市的灯塔里{NEWLINE}有一只很特别的电龙,{CLEAR}彩虹市的莉佳小姐{CLEAR}有一只很特别的臭臭花。{SCROLL}果然还是要多出去旅行,{NEWLINE}才能遇到各式各样的精灵啊。
strings.en: I heard there’s a very special{NEWLINE}Ampharos in the Olivine City lighthouse,{CLEAR}and Ms. Erika in Celadon City has a very{CLEAR}special Gloom.{SCROLL}You really have to travel a lot to meet{NEWLINE}all kinds of Pokémon.

strings.zh: 不愿意交换吗？{NEWLINE}果然还是嫌我的丑丑鱼太丑了吗……
strings.en: You don’t want to trade? I guess my{NEWLINE}Feebas really is too ugly after all...

strings.zh: 我要的是角金鱼,{NEWLINE}不要拿别的精灵糊弄我。
strings.en: I want a Goldeen. Don’t try to fob me{NEWLINE}off with some other Pokémon.

strings.zh: 太好了,多亏了你我才能拥有{NEWLINE}角金鱼这么棒的观赏精灵。
strings.en: Great! Thanks to you,{NEWLINE}I’ve got a gorgeous ornamental Pokémon{CLEAR}like Goldeen.

strings.zh: 丑丑鱼除了丑了点,{NEWLINE}性格还是蛮温柔的。{CLEAR}你如果能好好照顾它,{CLEAR}它一定会报答你的。
strings.en: Feebas may be a little ugly,{NEWLINE}but it’s pretty gentle by nature.{CLEAR}If you take good care of it,{CLEAR}I’m sure it’ll repay you.

strings.zh: 你知道口袋妖怪灯谜是什么吗？
strings.en: Do you know what Pokémon lantern{NEWLINE}riddles are?

strings.zh: 不知道啊,{NEWLINE}那就由我来告诉你吧。{CLEAR}所谓的口袋妖怪灯谜,{CLEAR}就是以前每逢过年的时候,{CLEAR}写在灯笼上的谜题。{CLEAR}无论谜面是什么,{CLEAR}答案都是一种口袋妖怪。{CLEAR}过往的游客可以{CLEAR}一边赏花灯,一边猜谜题,趣味十足。
strings.en: You don’t? Then let me tell you.{SCROLL}Pokémon lantern riddles were puzzles{NEWLINE}written on lanterns every New Year{CLEAR}in the old days. Whatever the clue,{CLEAR}the answer is always a Pokémon.{SCROLL}Passing visitors could admire the{NEWLINE}lanterns and guess the riddles at the{CLEAR}same time. It was great fun.

strings.zh: 没错,就是以前过年时{NEWLINE}根据谜面猜口袋妖怪的游戏。
strings.en: That’s right. It’s the old New Year{NEWLINE}game of guessing a Pokémon from a clue.

strings.zh: 爷爷我可是知道很多{NEWLINE}口袋妖怪灯谜哦,{CLEAR}你有兴趣跟爷爷玩一轮猜谜吗？
strings.en: Grandpa here knows lots of Pokémon{NEWLINE}lantern riddles. Want to play a round{CLEAR}with Grandpa?

strings.zh: 是吗……现在的年轻人{NEWLINE}对以前的游戏都不感兴趣了吗。
strings.en: Is that so... Young people these days{NEWLINE}just aren’t interested in the old{CLEAR}games anymore.

strings.zh: 哈哈,那你可要听好我的规矩,{NEWLINE}猜灯谜的谜面我会正常描述,{CLEAR}但是你的谜底必须要用那个精灵的{CLEAR}「全国图鉴」的「编号个位数」进行作答。{SCROLL}下面我要出第一题了：{SCROLL}头有角来脖子长,长发飘逸披肩上,{NEWLINE}脚杆细长蹄子亮,撒腿一跑嗒嗒响。
strings.en: Ha ha, then listen closely to my rules.{NEWLINE}I’ll read each clue as usual, but you{CLEAR}must answer with the last digit of the{CLEAR}Pokémon’s National Pokédex number.{SCROLL}Here comes the first riddle:{SCROLL}A horn on its head, a neck so long,{NEWLINE}its flowing mane sweeps right along.{CLEAR}Its legs are slim, its hooves all shine;{CLEAR}clip-clop, it gallops down the line!
strings.notes: riddle answers are the last digit of the National Dex number (#103-#110 = 1-8); rhymed English versions of the zh riddles (horse with a horn, round body with antennae, dragonfly, crab, duck)

strings.zh: 下面是第三题：{SCROLL}眼如铜铃、身像铁钉,{NEWLINE}有翅无毛,有腿难行。
strings.en: Here’s the third riddle:{SCROLL}Eyes like bronze bells,{NEWLINE}a body like a nail,{CLEAR}wings without feathers,{CLEAR}legs weak and frail.

strings.zh: 下面是第二题：{SCROLL}头圆手圆身体圆,{NEWLINE}眼睛圆圆有天线。
strings.en: Here’s the second riddle:{SCROLL}Round head, round hands,{NEWLINE}a body round too,{CLEAR}round eyes, and antennae{CLEAR}poking through.

strings.zh: 没有全部答对哦,{NEWLINE}再好好想想吧。
strings.en: You didn’t get them all right.{NEWLINE}Have another good think.

strings.zh: 居然全都答对了！{SCROLL}看不出来你年纪轻轻{NEWLINE}思维和见识都这么超群。{CLEAR}这个送给你就当做是奖励吧。
strings.en: You got every single one right!{SCROLL}Who’d have thought someone so young{NEWLINE}would have such a sharp mind and such{CLEAR}broad knowledge?{SCROLL}Please take this as your reward.

strings.zh: 猜灯谜是从很久以前{NEWLINE}流传下来的节日娱乐项目,{CLEAR}希望你们年轻人也能够{CLEAR}在猜谜中找到乐趣吧。
strings.en: Lantern riddles are a holiday pastime{NEWLINE}handed down from long, long ago.{CLEAR}I hope you young folks can find some{CLEAR}fun in them too.

strings.zh: 他还没有出门啊……
strings.en: He still hasn’t gone out, huh...

strings.zh: 啊哈哈,没什么没什么。
strings.en: Ah ha ha, it’s nothing, nothing.

strings.zh: 情况确认……
strings.en: Situation confirmed...
